items.difficulty_reason: Four-step inference chain, each step explicit: (1) vanishing of higher direct images from the affine case lemma; (2) exactness of f_{QCoh,*} because its derived functors form a delta-functor with vanishing positive terms (delivered earlier in this chapter); (3) direct sums commute by the cited direct-sums lemma; (4) all colimits commute since exact + direct sums gives all finite colimits and filtered colimits.
